It isn't required, but I recommend adding a tablespoon of vanilla to extract a little more flavor from your chocolate. Done correctly, you can have a custard that is either custard in chocolate or chocolate in custard. The alcohol in the vanilla also tends to make your chocolate sit higher in the custard.
